  <bpmn:message id="Message_NewJobOffer" name="New job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_HireOffer" name="Company wants you to work for them"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_FindJob" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindJob" name="Find a Job">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_JobApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ReceiptConfirmed" name="Application receipt confirmed and rated" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_ConfirmationReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_NewOffer" name="New job offer" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_NewOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_HireOffer" name="Company wants you to work for them" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_HireOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CompanyRating" name="Company rates you" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_CompanyRatesYou"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_JobPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OfferOnly" name="New job offer (no reporting)" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_OfferOnly"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_JobApplicant" name="Job applicant process" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_JobSearch" name="Job search started"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportMerge" name="Reporting merge"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Report companies with job applications"/>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_Wait_Event" name="Next event"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ConfirmationReceived" name="Application receipt confirmed and rated">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ConfirmationReceived" messageRef="Message_ReceiptConfirmed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_NewOffer" name="New job offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_NewOffer" messageRef="Message_NewJobOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_HireOffer" name="Company wants you to work for them">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_HireOffer" messageRef="Message_HireOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewOffer" name="Review job offer"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate job interview"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProbation" name="Enter probation phase"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Post_Split" name="Start post-probation activities"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CompanyRatesYou" name="Company rates you">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CompanyRating" messageRef="Message_CompanyRating"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Post_Join" name="Post-probation ratings completed"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_JobPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_JobPermanent" messageRef="Message_JobPermanent"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Rating_Decision" name="Rating of company" default="Flow_RatingAboveC"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Offers_Merge" name="Offers merge"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OfferOnly" name="New job offer received (no reporting)">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OfferOnly" messageRef="Message_NewJobOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewOfferOnly" name="Review job offer"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferOnly_Decision" name="Keep receiving job offers?" default="Flow_OfferOnly_Stop"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReviewTimer" name="One year elapsed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_ReviewYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ViewReviews" name="View company reviews"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReviewsViewed" name="Company reviews viewed"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_JobSearchEnded" name="Job search ended"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_to_ReportMerge" sourceRef="StartEvent_JobSearch" targetRef="Gateway_ReportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportMerge_to_Report" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportMerge" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Report_to_Wait" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Gateway_Wait_Event"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_to_Confirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_Wait_Event" targetRef="Event_ConfirmationReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_to_NewOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_Wait_Event" targetRef="Event_NewOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_to_Hire" sourceRef="Gateway_Wait_Event" targetRef="Event_HireOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_to_ReportMerge" sourceRef="Event_ConfirmationReceived" targetRef="Gateway_ReportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NewOffer_to_Review" sourceRef="Event_NewOffer" targetRef="Task_ReviewOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_to_Negotiate" sourceRef="Task_ReviewOffer" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiate_to_ReportMerge" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_ReportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hire_to_Probation" sourceRef="Event_HireOffer" targetRef="Task_EnterProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Probation_to_Split" sourceRef="Task_EnterProbation" targetRef="Gateway_Post_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_to_RateCompany" sourceRef="Gateway_Post_Split" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_to_CompanyRating" sourceRef="Gateway_Post_Split" targetRef="Event_CompanyRatesYou"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_to_ReviewTimer" sourceRef="Gateway_Post_Split" targetRef="Event_ReviewTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateCompany_to_Join" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_Post_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyRating_to_Join" sourceRef="Event_CompanyRatesYou" targetRef="Gateway_Post_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_to_Permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_Post_Join" targetRef="Event_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Permanent_to_Decision" sourceRef="Event_JobPermanent" targetRef="Gateway_Rating_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingC_OrLess" name="Rated company C or less" sourceRef="Gateway_Rating_Decision" targetRef="Gateway_Offers_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingAboveC" name="Rated above C" sourceRef="Gateway_Rating_Decision" targetRef="End_JobSearchEnded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers_Merge_to_Event" sourceRef="Gateway_Offers_Merge" targetRef="Event_OfferOnly"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferOnly_to_Review" sourceRef="Event_OfferOnly" targetRef="Task_ReviewOfferOnly"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewOfferOnly_to_Decision" sourceRef="Task_ReviewOfferOnly" targetRef="Gateway_OfferOnly_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferOnly_Continue" name="Keep receiving job offers" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferOnly_Decision" targetRef="Gateway_Offers_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferOnly_Stop" name="Stop receiving job offers" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferOnly_Decision" targetRef="End_JobSearchEnded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewTimer_to_View" sourceRef="Event_ReviewTimer" targetRef="Task_ViewReviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_View_to_End" sourceRef="Task_ViewReviews" targetRef="End_ReviewsViewed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReceiptConfirmed" name="Application receipt confirmed and rated"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_NewJobOffer" name="New job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_HireOffer" name="Company wants you to work for them"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyRating" name="Company rates you"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_JobPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent"/>
</bpmn:definitions>
